newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy FY97 markdown reserve rises.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy FY97 markdown reserve rises.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said Wednesday that its inventory markdown reserve for fiscal 1997 increased by approximately $25 million or 0.3 percent of sales.
The total amount of the inventory markdown reserve was not specified.

Best Buy said the increased reserve included $15 million recorded in the third quarter primarily related to personal computers. An additional $10 million taken in the fourth quarter related mainly to its decision to narrow the assortment of recorded music offered for sale in its stores.
Earlier, Best Buy reported net earnings for the fourth quarter ended March 1 of $0.20 a share, down from $0.46 a year ago. For the year, it earned $0.04 a share, down from $1.10 a year ago.
Interest expense in the fourth quarter declined to $9.7 million from $12.1 million as lower inventories contributed to lower borrowings.
Fiscal 1997 interest expense, however, rose to $50.3 million from $43.6 million due to increased levels of investment.

The company said it ended the fiscal year with $90 million in cash and has had minimal daily bank borrowings since mid-December. It is currently in compliance with all covenants in its bank working capital facility.
Best Buy said its financial position has improved, compared to the prior year-end, as inventories are about $70 million lower including the addition of 21 new stores.
The company said its investment in developed property declined by more than $70 million as more than $100 milion was realized through the sale and leaseback of properties in fiscal 1997.
